principle: The patterns this course teaches all reduce tokens and maintain focus — i.e. they ARE the 'unbounded & inefficient -> most-bounded & most-efficient' descent we already formalize. We LEARN the patterns; we never vendor or execute the LangGraph/deepagents orchestration runtime (that is the foil, not our runtime); every pattern output is a CANDIDATE the verification rail dispositions, never truth-by-assertion.
wedge: deep-agents teaches how to MANAGE context (where it lives, how little to carry). Baltor/Teleon governs whether that context is TRUE, CURRENT, and PROVABLE. The offloaded file, the sub-agent's output, and the summary are candidates, not facts — same framing as the context-layer-openness thesis: they manage where context lives; we govern whether it's true.

patterns.name: TODO / plan tracking
patterns.does: an explicit pending/in_progress/completed plan keeps a long-running agent focused and bounded
patterns.maps_to: worker bucket: orchestration; descent: bound the task scope
patterns.governed_note: a plan is a candidate control structure, not a source of truth; it never promotes a fact

patterns.name: virtual-filesystem context offloading
patterns.does: persist information outside the prompt window (to files) so the live context stays small
patterns.governed_note: offloaded content is a candidate; its provenance + verification status ride in the sidecar, not inline

patterns.name: sub-agent delegation with focused tool sets
patterns.does: isolate context per sub-agent so specialized work does not interfere with the main thread
patterns.maps_to: worker bucket: bounded-agent provisioning behind a port (sandboxed)
patterns.governed_note: a sub-agent is a candidate bounded agent; sandboxed; its output is dispositioned, never served as truth

patterns.name: summarization / ReAct history compression
patterns.does: compress conversation/history to stay within a token budget while keeping the thread coherent
patterns.governed_note: LOSSLESS DISTILLATION applies: a summary may shrink the surface only if answer-critical facts + source handles + held-out warnings survive; raw + lineage preserved

non_goals: do NOT vendor or pip-install deepagents/langgraph as a runtime
do NOT let any pattern output serve truth without passing the verification rail
do NOT treat a sub-agent or summary as a promotion authority
